test_put_hdfstore: test HDFStore.put() to write DataFrames and Series to fixed or table format HDF files
test_put_compression: test HDFStore.put() with compression options like zlib and blosc for table format stores
test_put_append_validation: test HDFStore.put() raises ValueError when appending to non-table format stores
test_put_multiindex_columns: test HDFStore.put() with MultiIndex columns and data_columns constraints
test_put_datetime_series: test HDFStore.put() with datetime-typed Series using Timestamp.as_unit()
